display_long_description:
# Purposeful Practice. Confident Care.
Osso Nurse Training is the nursing-focused experience from Osso VR, the leading immersive platform for procedural skills in healthcare. Built for health systems, Osso Nurse Training combines the Osso VR Nursing Series and Osso Loop™ learning platform to transform hands-on practice into measurable proficiency, ensuring consistent training and helping to build a confident, practice-ready nursing workforce at scale.

This app requires an organizational education or enterprise subscription.

# More ways to train with less strain

With Osso Nurse Training’s multimodal design, nursing leaders can combine independent practice, peer collaboration, preceptor-guided sessions, and proficiency assessments to increase training throughput and shorten time to independent practice for new nurses.

# Support faster onboarding, procedural skill development, and performance tracking across critical, must-know areas.

Train for high-priority, high-liability skills with VR scenarios that mirror real workflow and reinforce best practices. Performance insights map to leadership metrics through the Domains of Excellence™ framework to help align training with safety, quality, and readiness goals.
